2.notice: Many students answer (A) mass and velocity, which is the usual textbook answer. MSTA's key gives (B), because kinetic energy can also be written in terms of momentum. In PYQ Vault mocks this question is awarded to every candidate.

15.notice: As printed this question cannot be settled: the buoyant force on a fully submerged object depends only on its volume, and no sizes are given. MSTA's key gives (C), which holds if the four objects have the same mass. In PYQ Vault mocks this question is awarded to every candidate.

61.notice: Option (A) is also right: the eyelids are moved by striated (skeletal) muscle too. MSTA's key gives (C), the movement of arms and legs. In PYQ Vault mocks this question is awarded to every candidate.

81.notice: Statement 1 depends on how it is measured: the United States makes the most electricity from waste in total, while Japan burns the largest share of its own waste. MSTA's key gives (D), all four. In PYQ Vault mocks this question is awarded to every candidate.

96.notice: Options (A) and (B) both describe Gaganyaan loosely: it is a crewed mission to low Earth orbit. MSTA's key gives (B). In PYQ Vault mocks this question is awarded to every candidate.
